items:
Switch the 
 instrument on and check the battery condition.

At the sample 
 point to be tested open the sample valve gently and check that no dirt or 
 condensate is expelled.

Connect the PTFE 
 sample pipe supplied with the instrument between the sample tapping point and 
 the instrument using either of the connections of the head / sensor assembly.

Adjust the sample value to give a gentle flow 
 through the instrument 
 (5-10 L/min) is 
 an ideal flow but the flow rate is not particularly critical. Don't exceed the 
 flow rate of about 20 L/min.

Place a finger 
 over the outlet connection of the instrument head and the sample pressure will 
 cause the head to open. Remove the finger when the head is fully open. (if 
 there is insufficient sample pressure, fit a length of 1 m or 2 m of 
 flexible pipe to the outlet connection of the instrument head and a slowly 
 raise the head by hand).

If the 
 instrument moves to a drier reading , this indicates that the original flow 
 rate was too low or that there is a leak in the system allowing ambient 
 moisture into the sample or that the sample pipe itself is still wet.

After the test 
 is complete , close the instrument head ready for the next test.

Power Station | Technical Procedure
Introduction
New gas has 15 ppmg 
moisture rate,
In circuit breakers and 
components equipped with dryers moisture < 40 ppmg.
In other component without 
dryers: moisture < 80 ppmg.
This document lists 
the testing procedures P1, which must be performed every three years as 
indicated by Y3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd Allah Alsayed Mohamed 
Alsyed, tested at 25 Jan 2004, accepted by 
general director eng. Alsyed Atiah Abd Almaqsoud, and 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader Mohamed Alnagar, approved by Head Sector of Talkha PS eng. Awad Soliman and EDEPCo. Quality 
Control Head Sector eng. Aly Al Lethy.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
The circuit breaker under 
test must be out of service.
Circuit breaker must be isolated & proper earthing at the two sides of CB area is required
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage)
Change remote/local switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Dew point meter ( C ) 
 type SHAW England
Thermometer ( C )
Screw driver, and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
The instrument reading will move ip to the 
 scale and then stabilize. When there is no further change in reading, note the 
 final result. If there is a doubt about the stability if the sample flow rate 
 or the material of the sample pipe being used, increase the sample flow rate 
 after the final reading has been obtained.
Switch the 
 instrument on and check the battery condition.
At the sample 
 point to be tested open the sample valve gently and check that no dirt or 
 condensate is expelled.
Connect the PTFE 
 sample pipe supplied with the instrument between the sample tapping point and 
 the instrument using either of the connections of the head / sensor assembly.
Adjust the sample value to give a gentle flow 
 through the instrument 
 (5-10 L/min) is 
 an ideal flow but the flow rate is not particularly critical. Don't exceed the 
 flow rate of about 20 L/min.
Place a finger 
 over the outlet connection of the instrument head and the sample pressure will 
 cause the head to open. Remove the finger when the head is fully open. (if 
 there is insufficient sample pressure, fit a length of 1 m or 2 m of 
 flexible pipe to the outlet connection of the instrument head and a slowly 
 raise the head by hand).
If the 
 instrument moves to a drier reading , this indicates that the original flow 
 rate was too low or that there is a leak in the system allowing ambient 
 moisture into the sample or that the sample pipe itself is still wet.
After the test 
 is complete , close the instrument head ready for the next test.
